title: Ordinary-limit and K-flat reduction realization data
statement: For strict-system Operations [def-strict-coefficient-system-operation-data], CanonicalBridge retains an ordinary direct-image isomorphism to the semilinear presentation fixed as the identity on every component section; its derived inverse and direct comparisons are adjoint conjugates [lem-sf-semilinear-proper-open-mate-pasting]. OrdinaryLimitModel retains ordinary direct image commuting with the coefficient limit, fixed on every finite projection. Its ordinary inverse-image mate gives reductionPullComplex. RealizationModel retains this ordinary datum, the derived reduction/inverse-image isomorphism, and its prescribed value on all good K-flat representatives [def-pur-completed-pullback-tower-core, lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. RealizationModel.push is its derived adjoint conjugate. The ringed operations here are precisely completed coefficient pullback, direct image and exact open extension [def-strict-coefficient-ringed-geometric-data]. No finite-expression interpretation, completion unit, or constructible realization is included.
